Educator Certification Naming Conventions

Courses submitted for Educator Certification credit must follow ALSDE’s standard naming and description conventions so they can be reviewed and approved efficiently.

Required Title Format
LEA_Provider_Title of Professional Development
Examples of Title Format
  • Baldwin County_Learning Jumpstart_Text-Dependent Writing Objectives
  • ALSDE_ARI_Dyslexia Awareness
  • Blount County_Blount County Literacy Coach_Science of Reading Foundations
  • Marion County_Marion County CTE_AI for Educators
  • Lee County_Auburn University_MTH 3311 Mathematics for Educators
  • JSU_RIC_Designing Math Instruction with Clarity
Approved LEA Examples
  • Montgomery County, Opelika City, Mobile County
Examples of What Not to Use
  • Montgomery Public Schools, Montgomery County Schools, MPS

Educator Certification Course Description Convention

The description should include the Subject Area Credit Type in bold at the beginning.

Required Course Description Format
Content Area: Description
Examples of Course Description Format

ENGLISH LA and SOCIAL STUDIES: This professional learning session is designed for high school educators to strengthen literacy while deepening content-area instruction. Participants will explore evidence-based instructional strategies that enhance reading comprehension, text analysis, historical thinking, source evaluation, and disciplinary writing. The session will focus on using literary and informational texts, primary and secondary sources, and inquiry-based learning to develop students’ critical thinking, argumentation, and evidence-based communication skills. Emphasis will also be placed on aligning instruction with Alabama English Language Arts and Social Studies standards to improve student achievement across both content areas.

EDUCATOR ETHICS: This course provides an in-depth study of ethical leadership and professional responsibility in education. Topics include the educator code of ethics, professional boundaries, student privacy and confidentiality, ethical use of technology and artificial intelligence, conflict of interest, mandatory reporting requirements, and equitable decision-making. Through case studies and reflective practice, participants develop the knowledge and skills necessary to navigate ethical dilemmas, maintain public trust, and support a positive school culture in accordance with state and professional standards.

Part 1 - Build the Course

Part 1

Build the Course and Align to Standards

  1. 1

    Click the Professional Learning menu, then click the Build button on the left side of the screen.

  2. 2

    On the Build Courses and Sections screen, click the Build Course/Section button.

  3. 3

    Select Course Type (Instructor Led Course, Self Paced Course, or PLC) and click Continue.

  4. 4

    Give the course a Course Title following the title naming convention and choose the Office from the drop list. (Offices are listed alphabetically if you have access to more than one.) Click Create.

  5. 5

    Enter a Course Description (following the description format above), including the Subject Area Credit Type in bold at the start.

    Tip: Click View Instructions to see the title format and course description format.
  6. 6

    Select the appropriate Credit Area(s) for the course and enter the number of professional learning hours for each selected credit area. A course may have one credit type or multiple credit types.

    Course SetupWhat To Do
    One credit type
    • Select the checkbox beside the applicable Credit Area.
    • Enter the number of hours in that area’s Units field.
    • Check that the selected area and hours are correct.
    Multiple credit types
    • Select the checkbox beside each applicable Credit Area.
    • Enter the number of hours in each selected area’s Units field.
    • Check that the selected areas and hours are correct.
    Tip: Click View Instructions to see the different credit types for certification renewal.
  7. 7

    Enter the Local Education Agency and Professional Learning Provider information.

  8. 8

    Choose the Delivery Time Frame and Method of Delivery.

  9. 9

    If you are an Office Administrator in the Office where the course is being created, you can bypass approval via the Bypass Course Approval drop box (choose “Yes”). Otherwise, the course routes to a Final Approver.

  10. 10

    Choose Post Session Survey 10-2026 for the Course Survey.

  11. 11

    (Optional) Use the File Attachment feature to attach any documents to the course.

  12. 12

    Click the Next button in the bottom-right corner.

  13. 13

    Click the Competencies tab. On this screen, select the applicable Alabama standards that align with the professional learning experience. Use the table below to identify which standards apply.

    Certificate CategoryDescriptionStandards Alignment
    Categories 1-5General Professional Learning: Educator Ethics
    • 2024 Professional Learning Standards
    • Alabama Code of Ethics
    Category 1Content Specific Professional Learning: Leadership
    • 2024 Professional Learning Standards
    • 2024 Alabama Standards for School Leadership
    Category 2Content Specific Professional Learning: Science of Reading
    • 2024 Professional Learning Standards
    • Alabama Core Teaching Standards (ACTS)
    Category 2Content Specific Professional Learning: Numeracy
    • 2024 Professional Learning Standards
    • Alabama Core Teaching Standards (ACTS)
    Category 3Content Specific Professional Learning: Speech Language Pathology
    • 2024 Professional Learning Standards
    • Alabama Core Teaching Standards (ACTS)
    Category 4Content Specific Professional Learning: Career and Technical Education
    • 2024 Professional Learning Standards
    • Alabama Core Teaching Standards (ACTS)
    Category 5Content Specific Professional Learning: All Other Area(s)
    • 2024 Professional Learning Standards
    • Alabama Core Teaching Standards (ACTS)
    Certificate category questions: Learn more about certification renewal requirements at alabamaachieves.org - Certificate Renewal.
  14. 14

    Click Course Tags and select the appropriate ones for the professional learning experience, then click Next.

  15. 15

    Click Visibility and use Manage Location to control who can find and register for the course. Statewide courses display AL; school- or district-level courses default to that school/district.

Part 2 - Create the Section

Part 2

Create the Section and Add Session Details

  1. 1

    Click Sections, then click Add Section to begin creating sections for the course.

  2. 2

    Enter the Section Title.

  3. 3

    Click Add Section.

    Section title: There is no required naming convention for the section title. The screenshot shows an example.
  4. 4

    Add the session details outlined in the following table.

    Section FieldWhat It Means
    Notes(Optional) Add notes about the professional learning experience. Hyperlinks can be added as well.
    Contact PersonThe person responsible for the professional learning. Include the name and email address.
    PresenterThe person conducting the professional learning. Include the name; the email address is optional.
    Delivery FormatSelect the appropriate description of the professional learning experience from the drop list.
    InstructorsInstructors manage the section roster, print sign-in sheets, mark attendance, and award credit. Consider adding yourself for easier access to rosters later.
    File Attachments(Optional) Upload applicable attachments.
    Location SettingsA location is required. Add “Online” in the Building/Room Number field if appropriate.
    Registration SettingsAdd the maximum number of participants who can register, and select the date and time people can begin registering. The End of Registration Date defaults to the Start Date if left blank.
    Waitlist Settings(Optional) Enable a waitlist and set a maximum size and cutoff date.
  5. 5

    Click the Class Times tab and enter the session dates and times. Click Add Class Time to add the start date and time; for multi-day trainings, click it again for each additional day.

  6. 6

    With Section Details and Class Times complete, click Submit Course and Section.

Bypass approval: If you were able to bypass approval, the course becomes available for registration on the date/time indicated. If not, a Final Approver in that Office must approve the course and section(s).

Part 3 - Review and Approve

Part 3

Review and Approve Submitted Courses

  1. 1

    Click the Professional Learning tab. Select Approvals, then click My Pending Approvals.

  2. 2

    Click a course or section title to review it.

  3. 3

    Review all details on the Course or Section Details screen, then click Review Comments in the upper-right corner.

  4. 4

    In the Tier 1 Approval window, select Approved and click Submit. If revisions are needed, select Needs Revision, enter an explanation, and click Submit. The original creator is emailed and can revise/resubmit under Build.

If you have questions or suggestions about the PowerSchool PL process, please contact us at pladmin@alsde.edu.

For certification-specific questions, contact the Educator Certification Section at edcert@alsde.edu or 334-694-4557.
